fields.title: Live folder sync that scales to very large folders (technical half)
fields.description: Technical half: a watcher event adds, removes or refreshes one book without a rescan; one full sync at a time, merged into the live library (positions and deletions survive); progress saved every 30 s; no callback after the watcher closes, and the startup folder work stops at quit (Fold-in 2a). Full sync moves to `main/folder-sync.js`. Design half (very large folders: import all, cap, or choose subfolders) is an open owner decision.
fields.notes: Created by the FOLDER-SCAN-PERF-1 close-out 2026-10-14. Technical half specified 2026-10-14 on main `b2dd36f0` (Blurby Brain ruling, Rule 11 tier 1): Full Spec, gates dry-run on the base and the prescribed edit. Merges after QUIT-FLUSH-1 (edits its `stopNewWork`) and before FOLDER-UNREACHABLE-GUARD-1. Owner check runs in a copy of the owner profile on the real Drive folder, inside the startup scan, with no import. The owner keeps sourceFolder cleared until this lands.
